goal: Introduce a cohesive helper type to encapsulate file metadata and refresh logic so that these responsibilities are separated from FileEntry.

ops.details: Create a new package-level class FileAttributes in org.apache.commons.io.monitor. The new class will declare fields: String name; boolean exists; boolean directory; SerializableFileTime lastModified; long length. Add constructors to initialize these fields from a java.io.File. Implement getters: getName(), getLastModified(), getLastModifiedFileTime(), getLength(), isDirectory(), isExists(). Implement setters: setName(String), setExists(boolean), setDirectory(boolean), setLength(long), setLastModified(FileTime), setLastModified(long), and a package-private setLastModified(SerializableFileTime). Implement a refresh(File) method that contains the logic currently in FileEntry.refresh(File) updating these fields and returning boolean indicating change. Do not modify FileEntry in this step except to add imports if needed later. Place FileAttributes in the same package (org.apache.commons.io.monitor).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
